facts.notes: Kamernet median rent for rooms (max 30 m2) advertised on Kamernet by private landlords/tenants/agencies; social student housing excluded. Advertised asking rents, not what existing tenants pay. RUG budgets € 450-650/month rent incl. energy. Q2 2026 report did not publish Groningen's figure.

facts.value: Not found on an official/citable source
facts.notes: RUG gives a single rent range (€ 450-650) without studio split; no studio figure in Kamernet.
RUG's own itemised list (rent 450-650, food 200-300, insurance 100-120, travel 70-80, study 80, phone 26, other 157) adds up to ~€ 1,080-1,410; the page does not explain the gap.

interpretations.hypothesis: Headline figure: € 800-1,000/month is what students spend on average.
Itemised figures on the same page sum to ~€ 1,080-1,410/month (our sum).

facts.value: No pass price found; RUG budgets € 70-80/month travel for students without a Dutch OV student travel card
facts.notes: Budget estimate, not the price of a Qbuzz/Arriva monthly pass.

facts.value: Temperate maritime: avg 2.8 °C in Jan, 17.5 °C in Jul; ~805 mm rain/yr; ~1683 h sun/yr (KNMI 1991-2020, Eelde)
facts.notes: Eelde (Groningen Airport) is about 10 km south of the city.

facts.value: Student life largely revolves around student and study associations (sports, culture, academic), plus pubs and city events.
facts.notes: National description; no city-specific official page checked for this city.

facts.value: No Dutch needed for English-taught programmes; English is widely spoken. Dutch helps for part-time jobs/internships and is sometimes required.
facts.notes: National source, applies to the whole country. RUG: Dutch course recommended but not mandatory; full-time internationals get 50 free hours of language classes.

facts.value: Popular student jobs: hospitality, retail, customer service, student assistant at the university, tutoring.
facts.notes: Page does not say whether Dutch is needed or how easy jobs are to find.

facts.value: Statutory minimum from 1 Jul 2026: € 14.99/h gross at 21+; € 11.99 (age 20), € 8.99 (19), € 7.50 (18). Same nationwide.
facts.notes: Legal floor, not a measured 'typical' student wage for this city; many student jobs pay at or near this minimum. Rates from 1 Jan 2026 were € 14.71 (21+).
